pages.title: It Is Not Up Here
pages.text: Gunpowder ore does not generate near the surface. It sits between $(l)y -128$() and $(l)y -64$(), in the deepest band of the world.$(br2)Creepers still drop it. But if you want $(o)enough$() gunpowder to feed a firearm, you are going mining, and you are going deep.

pages.title: Why It Is Gated
pages.text: Guns are not an early game option in this world - they are what you earn by surviving the bottom of it.$(br2)That is the trade the depths offer everywhere: the thing you want is under the thing that wants you.
